_written: 2026-11-02, before classify.py was run; approved by the user ('Lets run this analysis'), with the user's addition that non-significant signed TF-size footprint differences count as supporting evidence. Exploratory classification for a grant figure.
variants: the 104 designed SNVs with a ClinVar record (P/LP, B/LB, conflicting, VUS); results for all 633 also written

evidence.expression: Kircher 2019 LDLR: change if |log2| >= 0.5 and P < 1e-5 and LDLR.2 has the same sign; down/up by sign; sensitivity: |log2| >= 1
evidence.nucleosome: nucleosome-size change (gnomad_check / repeat3 endpoint, A7 mask, confident >= 81-bp calls); P = 2*sf(|z|); BH across the 104 ClinVar SNVs; gain/loss if q < 0.05

tf_footprint.window: positions within 10 bp of the SNV
tf_footprint.data: A10 E2 effects (A7 mask) for size bins sub_TF (10-19) and TF (20-40), unmasked rows; plus fp_features significant changes (A7, confident) of TF-size footprints whose span contains the SNV or lies within 10 bp
tf_footprint.significant: any A10 E2 hit (hierarchical FDR) in the window, or an fp_features significant TF-size footprint change as defined; direction = sign of the hit D (majority of hits; ties -> fp_features sign)
tf_footprint.supporting: otherwise, mean z (D/se over unmasked window rows, both bins) with |mean z| >= 1; direction = sign
tf_footprint.caveat: all within 10 bp of the SNV: possible Hia5 sequence effect until naked-DNA controls

motif.scan: motif_scan.py scoring (JASPAR 2026 + HOCOMOCO v14, FIMO-style exact P), best P over matches covering the SNV, WT vs variant
motif.breaks_activator: family SP/KLF (TF names SP1-SP4, KLF*) or SREBF (SREBF1/2, SRBP1/2): WT P < 1e-4 and variant P >= 10 x WT P
motif.creates: any motif: variant P < 1e-4 and WT P >= 10 x variant P (family reported)

evidence.visibility: A/T count within +/-5 bp of the SNV in the WT sequence, excluding the edited base; poorly visible if <= 2

expression_down: significant TF-footprint loss; else breaks an SP/KLF or SREBF motif; else supporting TF-footprint loss
significant TF-footprint gain (and no activator motif broken); else supporting TF-footprint gain with no activator motif broken
expression_up: significant TF-footprint gain; else creates a motif; else supporting TF-footprint gain
significant TF-footprint loss; else supporting TF-footprint loss
no_expression_change: nucleosome q < 0.05 or significant TF-footprint change

annotations_per_variant: evidence level of the call (significant footprint / motif / supporting footprint), nucleosome direction (closes = gain, opens = loss, none), HEK293T local and far change with clone count (>= 3 clones), drops-its-base flag
figure: panel b: one stacked horizontal bar per ClinVar class (P/LP, conflicting, VUS, B/LB) by category; variant table as source data
